description: Protected Areas Exclusion for - IRP is a series of datasets listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Energy Commission. The geospatial data reflected in this Protected Area Layer contain minor data versioning and consolidation updates from the previous Protected Area Layer. This layer extends outside of the geographic boundaries of California to include electrically-in-state southern Nevada and western Arizona areas of the CAISO. Coverage: California. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher California Energy Commission. Its tags are Busbar Mapping, CAOpenData, California Natural Resources Agency, IRP, TPP. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support heat network planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
